phase: P7 Windows: ONLINE GAME through real Winsock
adapter: native/Sources/NTSDRuntime/OriginalWindowsWinsock.swift (Windows only): OriginalRuntimeSockets over WinSDK Winsock 2 with the BSD adapter's declared contract (handles 0x100 step 4, the same WSADATA bytes, blocking until WSAAsyncSelect, FD_ACCEPT/FD_READ one delivery per arm re-armed by accept/recv, FD_CLOSE once, notifications on the main queue). Readiness: a watcher thread with WSAPoll (POLLRDNORM), then the same peek-based decision as the BSD adapter; the runtime has no real window for WSAAsyncSelect. Errors: the stack's WSAGetLastError values. Own host name: GetAdaptersAddresses' up, non-loopback IPv4 addresses. bind without SO_REUSEADDR (on Windows it would let a second process take an active listener's port, unlike BSD; the client's own bind of 12345 must fail as on macOS)
wiring: NTSDSDL uses OriginalWindowsWinsock on Windows and no longer requires --no-network; the exe imports WS2_32.dll and IPHLPAPI.DLL
